_readme: Contract scenarios for reward engine v2 (plan C3/C5). LEAD-OWNED: only the lead edits this file.
Both engines must load every *.json in this directory and assert: points, cashback_inr, value_inr (2 dp), rule_id, excluded, cap_deltas (exact keys and values; zero deltas omitted).
Cards use the v2 wire shape (plan C2). The top-level 'directory' replaces db/fixtures/merchant_directory.json for this file.
For an excluded result, rule_id is the matching exclusion rule (null for a card-level category exclusion).
Rounding modes (contract D7): floor | round (per block), none (fractional), points_half_up | points_floor (exact amount x rate / block, then rounded to whole points).
Optional per-scenario "assert": list of expect keys to compare (others ignored). Used for v1-shaped cards, whose v1 path doesn't produce every v2 field (D10).

scenarios.name: A1 app bonus within caps
scenarios.why: 10 pts/block in the PhonePe app; base 20 + bonus 180; both caps have room.

scenarios.name: A2 bonus cap partly used
scenarios.why: Only 50 bonus points left this month; base 20 still earns.

scenarios.name: A3 bonus cap exhausted keeps base
scenarios.why: A bonus-only cap stops the extra points, never the base rate.

scenarios.name: A4 floor rounding on small spend
scenarios.why: ₹199 is one ₹100 block: 5 points, not 9.95.

scenarios.name: A5 card-wide total cap binds
scenarios.why: Total cap leaves 50 points; the cut comes off the bonus first.

scenarios.name: A6 exclusion by category
scenarios.why: Fuel earns nothing and consumes no cap.

scenarios.name: A7 unknown platform and rail fall to base
scenarios.why: Platform is never inferred; unknown rail does not satisfy an online rule on a v2 card.

scenarios.name: B1 brand rule via legal-entity alias
scenarios.why: 'BUNDL TECHNOLOGIES' resolves to swiggy; 10% cashback.

scenarios.name: B2 below brand minimum falls to next rule
scenarios.why: ₹200 is under the ₹249 minimum; online 5% applies.

scenarios.name: B3 total cashback cap binds
scenarios.why: Only ₹50 of the brand cap is left; the rest earns nothing.

scenarios.name: B4 sub-brand matches parent rule
scenarios.why: 'INSTAMART BLR' resolves to instamart, whose parent is swiggy.

scenarios.name: B5 exclusion on cashback card
scenarios.why: Rent earns nothing.

scenarios.name: B6 base rate with its own cap
scenarios.why: Unknown rail, unknown merchant: 1% base, counted to the 'other' cap.

scenarios.name: B7 alias must match on word boundaries
scenarios.why: 'Swiggywala Store' is not Swiggy; online 5% applies.

scenarios.name: C1 eligible-spend cap then base rate
scenarios.why: ₹1,000 of spend headroom at 5%, the other ₹3,000 at the 1% base.

scenarios.name: C2 eligible-spend cap then zero
scenarios.why: Same spend, but this card pays nothing past the cap.

scenarios.name: C3 cashback kept to paise
scenarios.why: 5% of ₹333 is ₹16.65 — no block rounding for cashback.

scenarios.name: T1 whole points rounded half up
scenarios.why: 7,500 x 1.5% = 112.5 -> 113 (issuer rounds the final points, not per block).

scenarios.name: T2 whole points rounded half up, below half
T3 whole points floored
scenarios.why: 199 x 1.5% = 2.985 -> 2 under points_floor.

scenarios.name: L1 legacy-shaped card keeps v1 semantics
scenarios.why: Only DB defaults (rule_role 'earn', empty arrays, no cap_kind, no accrual_rounding): v1 path, where an unknown rail still matches a rail rule (D10).
